reason: For expand_task, the cited lines show the tool resolves a project tasks file, reads JSON from it, finds a task, and can return that task or expanded task data, so it can return non-public host/project file data. That same task file content is project-controlled and potentially attacker-controlled, so returned content is untrusted. The lines show local file/task mutation and calls to core expansion logic, but no arbitrary host command execution/eval and no delivery to an attacker-readable external destination such as an agent-chosen URL, public repo/comment, or recipient.
